baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence `أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا` joins a named end, dative orientation, and a repeated root whose second noun is possessed by that end.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intention initiates a quest, but the Hereafter governs the direction and fitting form of the work. The split inventory also exposes aimless drifting as the failure mode excluded by `لها سعيها`, so the criterion is congruence rather than exertion in the abstract.

activation_trace.role: Volitional inclination supplies the initiating orientation toward the named end.
Active seeking converts an inward wish into a quest for what is sought.
The later or other-than-first horizon supplies the quest's temporal destination.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object gives the threefold root a directed trajectory.
Intentional work and earning make the trajectory practical rather than merely aspirational.
The split mapping's unattended wandering supplies a negative edge: the possessive construction rules out motion left to go wherever it will.

changed_reading.before: Want the Hereafter and make an effort for it.
changed_reading.after: Let the later end set both the direction and proper form of the work; the verse tests whether enacted movement fits the end it claims to desire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The circumstantial clause `وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ` accompanies the striving rather than appearing only as a separate result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The believer's settled security and assent to a trusted claim form the operating state of delayed, future-directed labor. Faith stabilizes the course and is not merely an additional credential checked after the work.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal pressure under which trust must operate.
Directed movement supplies the ongoing activity held inside the believing state.
Settled security and trust supply steadiness while the desired end remains unseen and later.
Heart-level assent supplies confidence in the claim that makes present work for a deferred end intelligible.

changed_reading.before: Faith is an eligibility condition added alongside effort.
changed_reading.after: Faith is the settled, promise-trusting state in which a deferred course can remain directed and coherent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: In `كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا`, the striving itself, rather than only the agent or a payout, bears the passive predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The final clause gives the labor a realized status of recognition. Appreciation preserves the value and addressability of the work itself instead of translating the whole clause into an impersonal wage.

activation_trace.role: Work and earned action identify the thing that receives the final predicate.
Occurrence in time gives the appreciation the force of an established status rather than a bare wish.
Recognition of received good supplies the relational acknowledgment placed upon the labor.

changed_reading.before: The qualified people will receive a reward.
changed_reading.after: Their striving itself comes to stand as recognized; the process is not erased behind whatever recompense follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier grateful servant and the later thanked striving reverse the direction of the same root. Gratitude first moves from servant toward giver, then acknowledgment returns and adheres to the servant-community's work.

activation_trace.role: Obedient service supplies the relational posture in which the earlier gratitude is enacted.
The servant's active recognition of beneficence establishes the outgoing half of the reciprocal pattern.
The community's enacted work becomes the patient upon which returning acknowledgment settles.
Passive recognition supplies the returning half of the relation and attaches it to the effort.

structural_cues: 17:3 and 17:19 repeat a `كَانَ` plus ش ك ر predicate while switching from `شَكُورًا` as an agent-quality to `مَشْكُورًا` as a patient-quality.
The earlier predicate belongs to a servant; the later predicate belongs to the plural group's striving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and active-to-passive reversal; I infer a reciprocal gratitude circuit, while the live alternative is that the two predicates are independent uses of the same root.

changed_reading.before: `مشكورا` is a one-way formula for reward.
changed_reading.after: The grateful servant supplies a relational template: gratitude enacted through service returns as acknowledgment borne by the striving itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's returns, renewed turn, and paired `if you return, We return` change striving from one uninterrupted advance into a repeatable practice of re-entry after reversal. The split ر و د inventory makes oscillation visible, while the focus's threefold س ع ي gives recurrence a stable course.

activation_trace.role: Restoration toward a prior position supplies recovery after displacement.
A renewed round supplies repetition rather than a single irreversible pass.
Paired return after departure supplies the reciprocal cycle that can be re-entered.
Habitual recurrence converts repeated return into a maintained practice rather than accidental repetition.
The split mapping's back-and-forth hesitation supplies the instability that a proper course must organize.
Repeated purposeful movement turns return into resumed progress toward the same end.

structural_cues: 17:6-8 clusters return language before the focus, including an explicit conditional recurrence.
17:19 repeats س ع ي as verb, cognate object, and final subject, allowing the course to persist across episodes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies historical cycles and lexical recurrence; I infer that proper striving includes resumption and repair, while the live alternative is that the returns describe collective history without specifying an individual's practice.

changed_reading.before: Proper striving is a single linear push without interruption.
changed_reading.after: Proper striving can be a repeatable course that resumes after reversal; what is acknowledged is sustained re-entry, not a fiction of uninterrupted motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance toward what is most upright, followed by believers doing fitting works, resolves `سعيها` as normed labor. The desired end does not license a self-designed route; guidance supplies direction, uprightness supplies measure, and صلاح supplies fitness.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a true path supplies direction external to the striver's preference.
Upright balance supplies a criterion for judging whether movement is well aligned.
Purposive action supplies the concrete work through which guidance becomes embodied.
Suitability to a thing supplies the qualitative fit encoded by the possessive `its striving`.
Directed movement receives its route from the contextual guidance and upright measure.
Assent links the focus believer to the guided believers whose actions instantiate the fit.

structural_cues: 17:9 sequences guidance, believers, fitting actions, and recompense; 17:19 sequences desire, object-fitted striving, believer, and appreciation.
The root ء م ن recurs in both sequences, making the earlier action profile available to the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, uprightness, believing workers, and fitting action; I infer that these specify the quality of `سعيها`, while the live alternative is that 17:9 merely parallels rather than defines the focus criterion.

changed_reading.before: `Its striving` means a sufficient quantity of sincere exertion.
changed_reading.after: `Its striving` is work whose direction, balance, and fitness answer to guidance; volume cannot substitute for alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hasty human can call for harm as though calling for good, and the seeker of the immediate wants an accelerated result still bounded by divine will. Against that failure, 17:19 makes desire answer to a later horizon, its fitting course, and a believing state.

activation_trace.role: A call that can bring down harm supplies the concrete possibility that desire misidentifies its own good.
Inclination toward benefit supplies the intended good against which the harmful call is miscalibrated.
Premature acceleration supplies the cognitive-temporal cause of the miscalibration.
Repeated willing in the immediate-seeker clause shows that wanting does not command what is actually granted.
The immediate and its hastening supply the direct temporal counterform to the focus's later end.
Unhurried pacing gives the focus intention a discipline opposed to premature acceleration.
Acceptance of a later time prevents immediate delivery from becoming the test of truth.
Fitting work becomes the external test that keeps inward desire from authenticating itself.

structural_cues: 17:18 and 17:19 are paired `من` clauses with repeated ر و د but opposed objects: the immediate and the Hereafter.
17:18 separates the seeker's will from `what We will for whom We will`; 17:19 inserts `لها سعيها` before the outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful prayer, haste, and paired desires; I infer that `سعيها` is a temporal-ethical correction to fallible wanting, while the live alternative is that the pair contrasts destinations without diagnosing desire itself.

changed_reading.before: An intense or sincere wish for the right object is self-validating.
changed_reading.after: Wanting is fallible under haste; the later horizon, its fitting work, and settled belief jointly test whether the desire is rightly formed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attached account, extracted book, opened writing, and self-accounting make action durable and inspectable. This changes `سعيهم مشكورا` from praise of a final outcome into recognition of a preserved course whose details remain addressable.

activation_trace.role: Binding a judgment to its bearer supplies durable personal attachment between action and agent.
Composed writing supplies a stable medium in which the course can remain legible.
An opened written record supplies public readability rather than hidden or vanished action.
Reckoning supplies the operation that reads the preserved particulars back to the self.
The enacted course supplies the content retained in the contextual record.
Recognition supplies the positive address made possible once the labor remains legible.

structural_cues: 17:13 moves from something attached to the person to a produced, opened book; 17:14 commands the person to read and account.
17:19 makes `سعيهم`, not merely the people, the grammatical bearer of appreciation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an attached readable account and reckoning; I infer that appreciation preserves and recognizes the process, while the live alternative is that the record concerns judgment generally without specifying what `مشكورا` adds.

changed_reading.before: Only the achieved result matters, and the process disappears once it ends.
changed_reading.after: The course leaves an attached, readable trace; being thanked means the effort itself survives as recognized evidence, even where visible results do not disclose its value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate-seeker and the Hereafter-seeker are both extended from the Lord's gift, so worldly supply cannot discriminate which striving is appreciated. `مشكورا` names a valuation distinct from the visible distribution that reaches both orientations.

activation_trace.role: The immediate seeker's volition identifies the first of the two groups resumed by `these and those`.
Accelerated present receipt supplies the tempting but unreliable visible sign of approval.
Connected increase and support supply provision that is explicitly extended to both groups.
Bestowal supplies the shared source of what each group presently receives.
The negation of barring removes restricted access to provision as an acceptance test.
The particular work, rather than its worldly yield, remains the object under evaluation.
Relational acknowledgment supplies the value-marker that universal provision cannot by itself reveal.

structural_cues: 17:20's `كُلًّا ... هَؤُلَاءِ وَهَؤُلَاءِ` resumes the two opposed seekers of 17:18-19 and gives both an extension.
Only 17:19 predicates `مشكورا` of striving, while 17:20 predicates unrestricted gift across both groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision extended as gift to both orientations; I infer that material expansion is not an acceptance marker, while the live alternative is that the shared gift may differ in kind even if its source is universal.

changed_reading.before: Present abundance or successful output can be read as evidence that a striving is appreciated.
changed_reading.after: Present gift supports both orientations; `مشكورا` is a distinct recognition of the work and cannot be inferred directly from worldly supply.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to inspect differentiated ranks, followed by the Hereafter's larger degrees, turns the desired end from a single terminal point into a vertically differentiated field. Purposeful striving can therefore be read as a stepwise course whose appreciation is not merely binary.

activation_trace.role: Directed inspection supplies an explicit invitation to compare the differentiated pattern.
Differential rank supplies a value scale rather than a single undivided outcome.
Greater magnitude expands that scale specifically in the later field.
Movement degree by degree supplies the stepwise geometry applied to the focus course.
The later end anchors the differentiated field directly in the focus object.
Purposeful movement supplies the course capable of traversing differentiated degrees.

structural_cues: 17:21 immediately follows the paired seekers and repeats `الآخرة` before naming larger degrees and differentiation.
The focus repeats the movement root three times; the next verse supplies an explicitly graded spatial-value structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies larger degrees and stepwise ascent; I infer that `سعيها` can unfold as a graded course, while the live alternative is that the degrees rank final stations without describing stages or evaluations of striving.

changed_reading.before: The verse sets a binary threshold: qualifying effort either reaches one undifferentiated accepted state or does not.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledged striving opens onto a differentiated, stepwise field; proper effort can have larger degrees without losing the common criterion of fit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing prohibition places rival worship on a causal path to sitting and loss of support. Read backward, the focus believer's undivided trust is not only doctrinal qualification but the configuration that keeps purposeful movement from collapsing into arrested dependence.

activation_trace.role: Directed worship supplies the dependency whose division produces the closing failure state.
Withdrawal from action supplies the exact kinetic opposite of purposeful striving.
Inability to rise turns the result into sustained arrest rather than a momentary pause.
Weakening legs supplies the bodily image of support failing beneath the course.
Undivided security and trust supply the stabilizing countercondition to failed dependency.
Purposeful movement supplies the live course that divided reliance threatens to arrest.

structural_cues: 17:19 centers repeated motion; 17:22 ends its causal prohibition with `فَتَقْعُدَ`, a result-state of sitting.
The intervening verses move through extension, comparison, and degrees before the final warning against unsupported arrest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, cessation of action, inability to rise, and weakened support; I infer that undivided faith sustains motion, while the live alternative is that `فتقعد` is an idiom of condemned status rather than a kinetic commentary on striving.

changed_reading.before: `وهو مؤمن` is only a doctrinal modifier attached to otherwise self-powered effort.
changed_reading.after: Believing trust is also an anti-arrest condition: undivided reliance keeps the course mobile, while rival dependency ends in unsupported inability to continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates growth-response branches of ش ك ر rather than ordinary verbal gratitude. It remains anchored in `مشكورا`, whose inventory includes slight input showing visible effect and fresh shoots, while contextual growing good and connected increase reinforce the material analogy. Render it as a lexical image of receptive amplification, not a promise that every small act produces visible worldly growth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive `مَّشْكُورًا` is predicated of the threefold striving, allowing the work itself to be pictured as responsive material.

activation_trace.role: Stable, increasing good supplies a contextual growth environment for the focus's appreciated work.
Connected augmentation supplies the continuing input by which an initial effort can be extended.
Actual work supplies the seed-like input rather than a merely verbal wish.
A small provision whose effect becomes evident supplies the image of disproportionate responsiveness.
Fresh offshoots supply the image of acknowledged effort continuing beyond its initial act.

changed_reading.before: Appreciation is chiefly verbal commendation or a later payment.
changed_reading.after: Appreciated striving can be pictured as receptive growth: a genuine input becomes manifest, is extended, and sends out effects beyond the initiating act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the technical self-purchase branch of س ع ي and joins it to the nearby neck-bound record and nontransferable burden. It remains valid as a cross-domain mechanism anchored in the focus root and explicit contextual anatomy and liability. Render it only as an emancipation analogy for accountable effort, not as a claim that the verse establishes a literal manumission transaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated `سعي` carries an inventory branch in which labor earns release, while the focus makes that labor the object of acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: A judgment fastened to its bearer supplies the encumbrance from which the analogy begins.
The literal neck supplies the bodily attachment point that makes the release image concrete.
A heavy load that no substitute bears supplies nontransferable personal liability.
Labor toward one's release supplies the emancipation mechanism applied analogically to the accountable course.
Acknowledgment supplies the positive reception of that liberation-directed labor.

changed_reading.before: Striving accumulates merit in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Each person labors toward release from an attached, nontransferable account, and the release-directed labor itself is acknowledged.

strongest_changes: `سعيها` became an object-governed and guided criterion of fit rather than an unspecified quantity of exertion.
The 17:3 to 17:19 ش ك ر reversal made appreciation reciprocal and attached the returning recognition to the work itself.
17:11 and the paired 17:18 clause made desire fallible under haste, so faith and fitting labor calibrate rather than merely accompany it.
The readable account of 17:13-14 and universal gift of 17:20 separated durable recognition from visible worldly output.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits inside unusually dense reversals: grateful servant versus thanked striving, immediate desire versus the later end, personal work versus universal provision, motion versus final sitting, and a singular `whoever` whose acknowledged striving forms a plural class.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal gratitude circuit is strongly cued by form and sequence but remains a reader-supplied directional inference.
`سعيها` may encode qualitative fit, due measure, or both; the packet does not force a single relation.
The account-and-book sequence may preserve all deeds for judgment without specifically defining the force of `مشكورا`.
The growth and self-release readings should remain contained lexical analogies rather than controlling interpretations.
